behavior: Configuration retains caller-owned admin authorization, required reads, item-not-found and validation guards before every owner command
Configuration retains caller-owned before and after snapshots, audit actor and metadata, reloads, counters, return shapes and settings revalidation after successful owner persistence
edit accepts only title, canonicalStatement, tags and safetyLevel; unsupported-only runtime input remains a no-op while mixed input retains legacy audit changed-field metadata
edit title and canonicalStatement retain trim-based non-empty validation while tags and safety level retain exact runtime validation and empty defined patches do not write
archive, restore, verify, unverify, supersede and conflict workflows retain their prior guard, read, mutation, audit and revalidation order
verification keeps the legacy truthy non-boolean branch and actor handling; truthy whitespace identifiers remain accepted exactly where the caller used truthiness rather than trim validation
non-exact conflict actions retain the legacy clear-group fallback, and winner and loser mutations remain sequential with per-step audit
manual creation keeps caller-generated ids, exact validation and the sequence item owner write, existing source attachment, reload, audit and revalidation
source disable keeps its prior source query and disable result, strict isVerified-true or manual retention gate, marker behavior, truthy audit reason, counters and final audit
core reset keeps mode and typed-confirm guards, target and telemetry reads, per-item archive then audit ordering, final reset audit and revalidation
AI Knowledge owns all migrated item persistence through 13 closed versioned commands and named handlers; no generic update, SQL, model selector or transaction capability crosses the public boundary
the owner adapter contains 27 analyzer-visible static AiKnowledgeItem statements: 15 fixed non-empty edit masks and 12 fixed non-edit mutations, each with fixed SQL and bind order
trainer verification remains a separate pre-existing VerifyKnowledgeItemCommand.v1 lifecycle and does not call the governance verification command
bounded_drift: the 13 Configuration persistence sites move behind AI Knowledge public v1 handlers and one compatibility adapter
owner command results carry internal contract envelopes that do not change existing action return shapes
fixed raw SQL replaces caller raw SQL while retaining SQL mappings, database NOW timestamps and zero-row success behavior
additional parser, handler and adapter frames can change stack traces without changing caller-visible error propagation

deliberate_legacy_partial_success: conflict member mutations and audits remain sequential, so an earlier member can persist before a later failure
manual item creation remains durable before source attachment, so source failure can leave the item without its source or audit
source-disable item handling remains sequential after source disable and can stop after earlier successful item work
core reset remains per-item archive then audit and can stop after earlier successful item work before the final event

out_of_scope: database execution, physical rollback, locking, constraints and concurrency
deployed application runtime, service activation, provider transport, webhook delivery and provider tests
schema changes, deployment, production mutation and secret-bearing paths
trainer lifecycle redesign, UI redesign and later CRM-ARCH roadmap slices
